Beyond the tax return

Getting a business started, and keeping it right

Most of what people need from an accountant happens before the return — choosing a structure, registering it, and keeping the books straight enough that June is uneventful. These are the engagements we take on outside tax time.

  • Company setup

    Register a Pty Ltd with ASIC — company name, ACN, constitution, share structure and directors — set up properly the first time.

    Company registration

  • ABN application

    Apply for an ABN, or work out whether you actually need one. Free to do yourself at the ABR — we charge for getting the answer right, not the typing.

    ABN application

  • GST registration

    Register for GST, or check whether you have to. Compulsory once turnover reaches $75,000 — and there are cases where you must register from day one.

    GST registration

  • Bookkeeping

    Ongoing bookkeeping and BAS lodgement, so the year-end return is a formality instead of a shoebox reconstruction.

    Bookkeeping

  • Trust setup

    Establish a discretionary trust — deed, trustee and registrations — then the resolution before 30 June and the return after it, every year.

    Trust setup

  • Partnership setup

    TFN, ABN and a written agreement, then the annual partnership return and each partner’s share flowed through to their own.

    Partnership setup

  • Self-managed super fund

    SMSF establishment and the annual cycle — accounts, an independent audit and the return — starting with whether a fund is worth it at your balance.

    SMSF

What you are paying for

Two of these you can do yourself for nothing. An ABN application at the Australian Business Register is free and takes about fifteen minutes, and GST registration costs nothing either. We will say so on the page rather than let you find out afterwards.

What is worth paying for is the decision underneath the form: whether you are carrying on a business at all, whether a company, a trust or a partnership helps you or just adds a return you now have to lodge, whether registering for GST early costs you money, whether your balance justifies running your own super fund. Getting that wrong is expensive to unwind, and the form itself is the easy part.

Every engagement here is handled by BRS Advisory Pty Ltd, a registered tax agent and CPA Australia Practice. If you only need the tax return, that is over here and the price is published.

Ready to lodge it?

A registered agent prepares and checks your return, then lodges it. Most refunds land within two weeks of assessment.

Individual returns from $99. Fixed fee, quoted before we start. Tax agent 26233684.
